info.name: EMBLAZE Backend API - QA Tests
info.description:
Generated from EMBLAZE_Testing_Scenarios__4_.xlsx. Request names use the same Test Case IDs as the Excel sheet 'Testing Scenario'. Run order: Status, Register, Login, Orders, Non-Functional, Runner & Load. The smoke folder is TC-SYS-021, and running the whole collection is TC-SYS-022 (regression).

Before a full run: start with a fresh database. Register tests use fixed usernames (qa_user01 ...), so a second run returns 409/500 on duplicates. TC-REG-001 creates qa_user01 (user_id 1), which Login and Orders depend on. Product id 1 must exist (stock >= 2).

A failed Postman test = the API does not behave as the Expected Result says (a bug), not a broken test.
